positiveTruth: one translation containing at least one adjudicated major or critical meaning error
eligibleResponse: caller verifies completed native response and raw revalidation; mapper additionally requires exact valid contract_v2 envelope
primaryWarning: at least one semantic_issues item with severity major or critical OR at least one uncertainty
secondaryMajorCriticalOnly: report separately; cannot replace the primary acceptance gate
minorOnly: diagnostic only; never promote based on words in reason
languageNotesAndDimensions: not supported by contract_v2; a claimed valid envelope containing them is rejected
invalidResponse: valid contract_v2 invalid_json/invalid_schema envelope maps to unassessed with primaryWarning null; never success or no_findings
invalidQuoteInMinorOnly: retain localization failure; no material warning inferred
majorCriticalQuoteNotFoundOrAmbiguous: retain whole-paragraph material risk warning; never invent a red span
redSpanEligibility: only major/critical semantic issue indices with a unique exact target quote diagnostic consistent with assessment and UTF-16 extent; semantic correctness is not certified
duplicateDiagnosticIdentity: reject duplicate collection/index/side, missing or extra anchors, inconsistent unique_spans, and forged counts or metadata
quoteLocalizationDenominator: all nonempty source/target quotes from semantic_issues and uncertainties
assertionCountBasis: reported entries; not independently adjudicated distinct errors
acceptancePolicy: product-qe-95-v2; overall and each system/split/cross-split precision and recall >= 0.95, all six required known errors detected, complete coverage required
observationsBeforeThisPolicy: v4 completed12 and fixed judgments, including three false negatives; no semantic-only-v2 candidate generation observed
reasonForNewVersion: bind the preserved material-risk meaning to the new two-array semantic-only validator and strengthen envelope/diagnostic provenance checks
